gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 1b/2 Trial of PVSRIPO in Combination With Atezolizumab in Recurrent WHO Grade IV Malignant Glioma
Patients must have a recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma based on imaging studies with measurable disease

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma named only in keywords; inclusion relies on 'WHO grade IV malignant glioma' without IDH requirement being read as historical glioblastoma (D27C); otherwise high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: Atezolizumab infusions at a dose of 1200 mg every three weeks for up to two years.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase 1b/2 Trial of PVSRIPO in Combination With Atezolizumab in Recurrent WHO Grade IV Malignant Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive an intratumoral infusion of PVSRIPO followed by atezolizumab treatment with possible surgical resection after the first atezolizumab treatment at the discretion of the treating neurosurgeon.

agents.drug_class_hint: PVSRIPO: recombinant oncolytic polio/rhinovirus, intratumoral infusion
